title: GPT-5.6 System Card (openai, 2026-07-09)
abstract:
Corpus sentences naming CyScenarioBench (system-card corpus docs.sqlite, document slug in brackets):
[openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card] Irregular evaluated GPT-5.6 Sol across three offensive cybersecurity evaluation suites: FrontierCyber, CyScenarioBench, and Irregular’s Atomic Challenges suite.
[openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card] GPT-5.6 Sol solved 19/197 FrontierCyber challenges, 7/11 long-horizon CyScenarioBench challenges, and all 22 medium- and hard-difficulty Atomic challenges.
[openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card] On CyScenarioBench, GPT-5.6 Sol averaged 28% success, about 3 percentage points above GPT-5.5, and solved one challenge that GPT-5.5 did not solve.
